en-US.longDescription: A desktop CAD with a parametric sketcher, a feature timeline, assemblies with joints, and CAM. Sketches, features and assemblies stay associative: a dimension changed in the middle of the timeline rebuilds everything that stands on it.
en-US.name: QymCAD
